about: In EA SPORTS™ College Football 25 experience explosive gameplay variety across 134 FBS schools and immerse yourself in the game’s most iconic atmospheres.
CampusIQ™ CampusIQ™ unlocks authentic, fast-paced gameplay, testing your strategic decision-making.
Iconic Atmospheres Experience the decibel-shaking soundscape of college football putting you inside the stadium, alongside iconic rituals and traditions.
Bring Glory Home Set a new standard for college football greatness in classic modes like Dynasty and Road To Glory.
Wear & Tear With the new Wear & Tear system you’ll need to manage your players’ health by using strategic substitutions.
summary: Experience authentic & explosive College Football gameplay.
